name: 46319 · Griffith, IN
findings: ZIP 46319 (Griffith) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46319 (Griffith) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46319 (Griffith) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 20% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
